dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures along the mid-lateral flank exhibit irregular, serrated outer perimeters. These structures show a high-contrast gradient transition from dark charcoal exterior pelt to light-grey/off-white interior rings, particularly prominent in the central-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical, light-intensity pixel clusters is observed on the cranial-dorsal and neck regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and form a speckled concentration that transitions into more organized rings posteriorly.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct lateral 'O' rings form an obtuse scalene triangle pattern. The relationship between the posterior-most ring and the central-dorsal ring cluster defines a primary axis of symmetry for the visible mid-section texture.
